description: This file declares the 'Network' class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which serves as a server for JSONRPC communication. It provides interface declarations for network-related operations such as getting and setting network interface statuses, IP configurations, and handling network events. The file includes necessary headers, defines private member functions and callback handlers, and public methods for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network plugin class implementing JSONRPC communication for network management within the WPEFramework. It provides methods to handle network interface statuses, IP configurations, and event handling.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Retrieves certain operational quirks or features supported by the network plugin.

methods.name: getInterfaces
methods.description: Fetches list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific network interface is enabled.

methods.name: setInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the current default network interface.

methods.name: setDefaultInterface
methods.description: Sets the default network interface.

methods.name: getStbIp
methods.description: Gets the IP address assigned to the set-top box.

methods.name: setApiVersionNumberWrapper
methods.description: Sets the API version number used by the plugin.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumberWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves the current API version number.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Performs network trace (ping) to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: traceNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Performs network trace to a named endpoint.

methods.name: getNamedEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves a list of named network endpoints.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends ICMP packets (ping) to a specific endpoint.

methods.name: pingNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Pings a named network endpoint.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for network interfaces.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves current IP configuration settings.

methods.name: onInterfaceEnabledStatusChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when interface enabled/disabled status changes.

methods.name: onInterfaceConnectionStatusChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when interface connection status changes.

methods.name: onInterfaceIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when IP address changes on an interface.

methods.name: onDefaultInterfaceChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when default interface changes.

methods.name: eventHandler
methods.description: Static event handler for IARM events; delegates to member method.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Instance method handling IARM events.

methods.name: _getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Internal method to fetch the default interface and gateway.

methods.name: _doTrace
methods.description: Performs network trace to an endpoint and fills response.

methods.name: _doTraceNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Performs trace to a named endpoint.

methods.name: _doPing
methods.description: Internal method to perform ping to an endpoint.

methods.name: _doPingNamedEndpoint
